cases.name: Joanna Jean Jane Lockaby
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Born in Greenville, she was the daughter of James Dexter Lockaby and Crista McElhannon. Joanna was predeceased by her brother, Joe Avery James Lockaby."
cases.relationship: Brother / stepbrother / partner or sibling's brother / Brother-in-law
cases.narrative: On 7/19/2022, she was found dead in a plastic bin near a wooded area behind her home at 112 Chevy Chase Blvd. in Pelzer, SC. She died from suffocation due to entrapment.
